intro: The frame every public page stands in: header, menu, language, theme, quick contact, footer and privacy, then the page header, the section head and the closing invitation.

header.title: Header
header.intro: His name and fields on the start side, then the sections, then language, theme, sign-in and "Request a consultation" on the end side.
header.note: It stays at the top as the page scrolls. On phones only the name, the consultation button and the menu button stay. Signed in, "Sign in" becomes "My account" with a letter from the visitor's email.

menu.title: Phone menu
menu.intro: The index of sections over the page, with the current page marked by an accent line on the start edge.
menu.note: It opens over a scrim and keeps focus inside until it closes. Esc closes it and gives focus back to the menu button. Try it from the header's menu button on a narrow screen.

language.title: Language and theme
language.intro: The header shows only the other language's name, and one theme button that goes round device, light and dark and says its state in its name.
language.note: The default follows the device, and the choice is saved. On a page with no translation, the note says so in the language the visitor asked for, and offers the section's list or staying.

quick.title: Quick contact
quick.intro: A tab at the bottom start corner of every public page that opens WhatsApp, email and "Request a consultation".
quick.note: The number and the address are text that can be copied, because mailto and wa.me links don't work for everyone. No promise of a response time. It rises above the privacy bar while that is open.

footer.title: Footer
footer.intro: A short line in his voice, two indexes of the site, the newsletter, the contact channels, then the legal links.

skip.title: Skip link and privacy
skip.intro: The skip link shows on the first Tab. The privacy bar sits along the bottom and doesn't block the content.
skip.note: The two buttons look and weigh the same: declining is no harder than accepting.

pageHeader.title: Page header
pageHeader.intro: Where you are, then the title and one sentence of his, then the page's facts. Never a centred title.
pageHeader.sampleTitle: Every project here began with a question that had no easy answer.
pageHeader.sampleIntro: I write about each one as it happened: where we were, what I did, and what changed after I left.

section.title: Section head
section.intro: A heavy rule, then the title on the start side, a line of his, and "see all" with the count on the end side.
section.sampleIntro: Three projects I come back to when someone asks me: how do you work?
section.note: A section stands alone: it can be hidden or moved from the dashboard without breaking what's around it. An empty section is never shown.

cta.title: Consultation invitation
cta.intro: The closing invitation on public pages: an invitation to talk, not a coloured sales banner.
